title: Hazardous Redstone
description: Touching exposed redstone and redstone components will hurt, just like real life electricity! Inspired by BlockerLocker's video
body:
A Fabric mod that introduces an electric redstone hazard system, where powered redstone components and redstone networks can damage entities that come into contact with them. Now you can zap yourself and make fun traps and well idk what else you would do with this. 

## Features
- Any living entity touching exposed redstone gets shocked and damaged 
- Redstone wire: damage scales with the `power` blockstate  
- Redstone block: always deals full damage   
- Certain animals and monsters will be resistant or weaker to electricity, following real life rules! (Like Iron Golem)
